evidence.quote: As of 20 February, 2114 of the 55,924 laboratory confirmed cases have died (crude fatality ratio [CFR2] 3.8%)
The Joint Mission acknowledges the known challenges and biases of reporting crude CFR early in an epidemic.

The Joint Mission noted that the standard of care has evolved over the course of the outbreak.

T10.desc_zh: 转折描述：1/10–22 快速增长，1/23–27 达峰并平台，此后下降（2/1 报告尖峰除外）；1/23 武汉交通管制

evidence.quote: the epidemic rapidly grew from 10-22 January, reported cases peaked and plateaued between 23 January and 27 January, and have been steadily declining since then, apart from the spike that was reported on 1 February
On 23 January, Wuhan implemented strict traffic restrictions.

T11.desc_zh: 每日新增确诊 2478（考察首日）→409（考察末日）为报告日计数；下降有多源佐证（发热门诊等）

evidence.quote: 2478 newly confirmed cases of COVID-19 reported in China. Two weeks later, on the final day of this Mission, China reported 409 newly confirmed cases.
Several sources of data support this conclusion, including the steep decline in fever clinic visits
from a peak of 0.47% positive on 30 January to 0.02% on 16 February

evidence.quote: Approximately 80% of laboratory confirmed patients have had mild to moderate disease, which includes non-pneumonia and pneumonia cases, 13.8% have severe disease
may explain a relatively high R0 (2- 2.5) in the absence of interventions
